title: The ownership problem
subtitle: Five vendors. No owner.
description: Most small brands do not have a marketing problem. They have an ownership problem: a designer here, an ads freelancer there, a cousin who edits reels. Zannid started with a single question — what if the same team planned the month, shot the content, ran the ads and answered the DMs?

illustrations.alt: A folded paper note carrying the Zannid Z mark
Three loose paper pieces connected to a single black knot

title: One team, one invoice
subtitle: Strategy first, craft second, measurement always.
description: Not another content vendor. A growth team that owns the whole engine: strategy, reels and shoots, editing, design, Meta ads, creators, websites and AI automation, measured on growth rather than on post counts.

illustrations.alt: A glass sphere inside a black orbit ring
Five stacked paper strips in the Zannid palette

title: Nineteen services, five departments
subtitle: Brand, growth, websites, product, care.
description: The bench grew into departments. Every service became a set of named options with a timeline, so a neighbourhood café and a global D2C brand can buy the same standard of work at the scope that fits them.

illustrations.alt: A paper-cut camera with a warm glass lens
A strip of film cut from paper

title: Twenty-five brands, one standard
subtitle: Different categories. Same discipline.
description: Cafés and restaurants, real estate, education, retail, events and production houses, across India and internationally. The briefs change, the method does not: understand the offer, build the content, then measure what moved.

illustrations.alt: Paper bars rising left to right
Ascending paper chevrons with warm confetti

title: The next chapter
subtitle: Automation, product and the long game.
description: What is being built now: AI that answers DMs and books calls, products and platforms for brands that need more than a page, and relationships that outlast a monthly retainer. The next chapter gets written with the brands we work with.

An open paper window with light behind it
